==Blackjacking==
The probability to successfully knock out a bandit is independent of the blackjack used, and the same for both types of bandit (as well as for [[Menaphite Thug]]s). Knocking out either bandit rewards 10 Thieving experience.

If the player has [[line of sight]] to a second bandit when attempting to knock one out, they will be unable to, with a chat message stating {{mes|Perhaps I shouldn't do this here, I think another bandit will see me.}} Attempting to knock them out while in combat also fails, producing the message {{mes|You can't knock-out the bandit during combat.}}
